notes: Same-story detection across the whole archive. Candidates: TF-IDF over title/summary/keywords/characters/people (item units for non-episode items, segment units for story segments of episodes and multi-story items), plus shared central people; word 5-gram transcript containment separated rebroadcasts/clips (same recording, >=0.45) from real retellings (usually <0.1). Every accepted pair was judged by reading summaries (work/same_story/yes2.txt). Accepted pairs were grouped, expanded one hop to copies of the same recording (clips, rebroadcast episodes), and links were emitted between every item of one telling and every item of another, both directions. No links between items already linked by same_recording/clip_of/contains/aired_again_in/alternate_take/superseded_by, between parts of one telling (part_of_set/continues), or between different chapters of radio serials. evidence='content'. same_story_other_language when the items' primary languages differ (English/Yiddish). Back-links added for pass-1 same_story relations that lacked the reverse. 4 pass-1 same_story relations removed because transcripts show the same recording (rebroadcast/clip). remove_relation 'match' uses the schema field name target_id. Counts: {"add_relation:same_story": 859, "add_relation:same_story_other_language": 220, "remove_relation:None": 4}. Groups: 95 (pass2/story_groups.json). See 'review' for cases needing the user.
